description: Generate mock API responses from a schema. Creates realistic JSON responses for REST endpoints based on field names and types.

count.description: Number of records to generate (default: 1, max: 100)

fields.description: Array of field schemas. Each field has: name (string), type (string|number|boolean|date|array|object), optional items (for arrays), optional fields (for nested objects), optional nullable, optional enum.

status_code.description: HTTP status code for the response (default: 200)

wrap_in_envelope.description: Wrap response in { success, data, meta } envelope (default: true)

name: generate_api_mock
